Package edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services

Class DblpResolver

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services.DblpResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
CitationMetadataResolver
@Service public class DblpResolver extends Object implements CitationMetadataResolver
Client for DBLP's public search API (https://dblp.org/search/publ/api, no API key required), tried last in the resolver chain — see docs/design/OpenAlex-MVP-to-full-tiered-fallback-engine.md and issue #66. DBLP curates the CS literature catalog independently of Crossref/OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar, so it can have cleaner venue/pages/volume/number data than a very recently registered DOI has on the other three — at the cost of narrower (CS-adjacent-venues-only) coverage, and no abstract/publisher/isbn at all (not part of DBLP's schema).

DBLP has no dedicated by-DOI lookup endpoint, only free-text search — resolveByDoi(java.lang.String) queries using the DOI itself as the search text (DBLP's index includes each record's DOI, so this reliably surfaces it as a hit if DBLP has the record at all) and accepts only a hit whose own info.doi field matches exactly — the same confirm-by-exact-field-match approach CheckLinksService.confirmHandleViaDblp(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, edu.ucsb.cs156.jobs.services.JobContext) already uses for handle verification, reused here instead of a second copy of it.
